title: Travel Review Questions
description: Deterministic reviewer questions for travel blueprints.

entries.title: Who travels?
entries.description: Identify the traveller before judging the travel statement.

entries.title: Where is the destination?
entries.description: Identify the destination or origin explicitly.

entries.title: What is the context?
entries.description: Check for documentary, historical, fiction, or news framing.

entries.title: What is the intent?
entries.description: Determine whether the line is informative, evaluative, or fictional.

entries.title: Is it quoted?
entries.description: Check whether the line is quoted or reported speech.

entries.title: Is it only observation?
entries.description: Separate neutral observation from evaluative commentary.

entries.title: Is there a comparison?
entries.description: Decide whether the comparison is neutral or harmful.

entries.title: Is it evaluative?
entries.description: Identify praise, insult, mockery, or stereotyping.
